target.output: one durable winner plus loser collision receipts

title: Prove GitHub proposal-pin exclusivity under contention
problem: Discovery dedup is only proven with filesystem wx semantics; the canonical GitHub repository proposal-claim path has no host-specific create-if-absent race evidence, so many surplus workers can rely on an unverified exclusivity assumption.
mission: Run a bounded GitHub-host canary for the canonical discovery fingerprint pin. Give two or more contenders the same fingerprint and explicit isolated write authority, require the host create-if-absent primitive to elect exactly one durable pin, persist loser collision receipts, and prove no overwrite or authority promotion occurs.
acceptance: Two or more concurrent attempts for one fingerprint yield exactly one durable repository pin.
Losers receive durable collision evidence and do not overwrite the winner.
The winning pin bytes remain unchanged after all losing attempts.
Source proposal lineage remains preserved and no queue or authority promotion occurs.
A reopenable receipt records exact GitHub host results and commit references for winner and losers.

unblock_value.reason: Closes the explicit remaining boundary left by the discovery-dedup implementation before repository-host proposal dedup can be treated as exercised evidence.

regression_prevention.reason: Prevents a scaling assumption from graduating solely from local filesystem semantics when the actual swarm coordinates through GitHub contents writes.

information_gain.reason: Converts host collision behavior into durable winner/loser evidence that can be inspected by later stress verification and planners.

falsification: Two contenders both obtain successful create results for the same canonical fingerprint path.
Any losing contender overwrites or mutates the winner bytes.
Collision evidence cannot identify the winning pin and contender lineage.
The canary requires promoting the proposal to READY, Current, Human Accepted or Served to function.
The host-specific behavior differs materially from the exclusivity semantics assumed by discovery-dedup-lib.mjs.

source_freshness.note: Exact main and exact fingerprint path were refreshed immediately before the create-if-absent pin. Public EPOCH endpoint freshness was not available through the current tool surface, so no fresh EPOCH value is asserted here.
